title: poses and trajectories schema
description: Configuration for dynamic go target sequences

task_map.description: A map between the task type (a number) to the name of the trajectory

trajectories.description: Pre-defined trajectory for specified target. Currently support go home and go clean pose.

go_clean_home.description: The trajectory to go lower home or clean home or maintenance home

static_joint.description: No spaces allowed for the keys. Joint poses maintained by software team. These will also be parse to ros parameter server for backend use. The rosparam will be / + whatever the key string is. For example, global_home will be /global_home

clean_home.description: lower home or clean or maintenance position

chng_sp_joint_home_r.description: The home pose for change sandpaper

tool_changer_local_home_jnt.description: The home pose for tool changer

pre_transition_pose.description: Pre transition position. Mainly used for dual robots. Will be activated if one of the use transition pose flag is true

scan_transition_pose.description: Scan transition position. Mainly used for dual robots. Will be activated if use_scan_transition flag is true

reload_transition_pose.description: Reload transition position. Mainly used for dual robots. Will be activated if use_reload_transition flag is true

sand_transition_pose.description: Sand transition position. Mainly used for dual robots. Will be activated if use_sand_transition flag is true

custom_joint.description: No spaces allowed for the keys. Feel free to add more poses here. Joint poses maintained by SAE. These will be used for constructing the trajectory.

^[a-zA-Z0-9_]+$.description: No spaces allowed for the keys.

static_ext.description: No spaces allowed for the keys. Extender poses maintained by software team. These will also be parse to ros parameter server for backend use. The rosparam will be / + whatever the key string is. For example, global_home will be /global_home

custom_ext.description: No spaces allowed for the keys. Extender poses maintained by SAE. These will be used for constructing the trajectory.

^[a-zA-Z0-9_]+$.description: No spaces allowed for the keys.

path.description: Defines the sequence of poses you want the robot to follow.

joint_target.description: Choose a target from static joint pose or custom joint pose. To use static joint pose type static/<whatever-key> and to use custom joint pose type custom/<whatever-key>

ext_target.description: Choose a target from static ext pose or custom ext pose. To use static ext pose type static/<whatever-key> and to use custom ext pose type custom/<whatever-key>

move_extender.description: Specify whether to move the extender to ext_target or not. Developed for dual robot. But can also be helpful if you have a tight space for single robot.

plan.description: Specify whether to plan for this motion or not. If used correctly can reduce cycle time. Use this carefully as this might cause collision.
